title: Do not waste the peace forgiveness brings
summary: This meets the quiet after pardon, when peace has returned but devotion has not yet answered it. The line treats forgiveness as the beginning of worship, not the end of crisis.
lifeApplication: After peace returns, sing or read Bani before filling the room with ordinary noise again.

source.shortMeaning: Forgiveness asks to be answered with devotion.
source.lifeApplication: After peace returns, answer it with Bani before ordinary noise takes over.

evidence.coreClaim: Forgiveness asks to be answered with devotion.
evidence.turn: Received forgiveness becomes lasting peace when it ripens into Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: After peace returns, sing or read Bani before filling the room with ordinary noise again.
